PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: fx-spear-to-ash
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FX-SPEAR-TO-ASH — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Extreme close-to-medium cinematic FX still of a hell guardian war spear at the exact instant divine authority unmakes it into ash before Hell's Gate. The weapon is a tall two-handed spear of corroded black iron fused with bone, longer than a man is tall, shaft scarred by ancient hammer work, dark rivets, and a barbed leaf-shaped blade that once dripped living dark viscous ichor from tip and iron collar. In this frozen beat the spear is dying mid-hold. From blade tip downward, solid black iron and bone flake into gray-white ash; edges crumble like burnt parchment; the point is already powder; the mid-shaft spiderwebs with faint gold fracture lines where power has touched the metal without flame or impact. Ash peels in thin sheets and granular clouds that still hold the spear silhouette for one heartbeat before collapsing into drifting particulate. The ichor has gone inert mid-drip, becoming charcoal dust falling between armored fingers.

Massive gauntleted hands of the Guardian Leader still grip the powderizing shaft—towering scale implied by iron-plated fingers, armor corroded black with battle scars and dried blood, rivets loose with age. Fingers lose purchase as ash spills through gauntlet joints and down wrist guards. Prefer spear and hands as the optical hero; if any guardian body appears, show only torso and arms in corroded black iron, helmet crest cropped or soft, no face required in frame.

Setting: approach to Hell's Gate inside the fortress cathedral of suffering. Deep crimsons and obsidian blacks; cold blue torch light near 2000K casting long hard shadows across black stone; red underglow near 3500K along floor seams. Soft in depth, the colossal iron-and-bone gate rises as a wall of damned-face carvings and corroded bronze fittings. Layered smoke, fine black dust, floating ash. From off-frame, restrained ethereal gold and warm amber divine rim light near 6500K kisses the crumbling spear and nearest armor edges—the only warm key in a cold hell palette. This is not fire consuming the weapon; authority unmakes it without sparks, molten drip, or theatrical lightning.

Camera: 50–85mm prime feel, slight low three-quarter looking up the dying shaft so threat remains even as the weapon fails; shallow depth of field isolating the mid-disintegration zone; ash motes catch light in foreground and mid-ground; aspect ratio 2.39:1. Particulate truth: flat flakes, fine powder, residual metallic scale with last sheen before collapse. Color grade locked to pre-transformation hell: deep crimson #8B0000, obsidian #0A0A0A, cold royal-blue torch accents, restrained gold only on spear and armor rims. Photoreal live-action biblical epic, sacred and severe—not gore spectacle, not fantasy sparkle, not CGI cartoon. No modern objects, logos, readable text, watermarks, UI, captions, or borders. Continuity: screenplay beat when Jesus merely looks and the guardian spear turns to ash in his hands—before the gate shatters, before guardians dissolve. One spear only, iron-and-bone to gray-white and charcoal ash mid-fall.
